title: A transcendental-rank obstruction to surface hosts
exact_target: For a very general cubic fourfold $X$, is there a surface $S$ such that the Kuznetsov component $Ku(X) \subset D(X)$ has an embedding $Ku(X) \hookrightarrow D(S)$?
